item.title: [UPDATED] Send your location via satellite on your Apple Watch Ultra
item.description:
With Apple Watch Ultra 3 and later, you can send your location via satellite when you’re off the grid with no cellular and Wi-Fi coverage.

21 added · 17 removed

-# Send your location via satellite on your Apple Watch Ultra 3
+# Send your location via satellite on your Apple Watch Ultra
-With Apple Watch Ultra 3, you can send your location via satellite when you’re off the grid with no cellular and Wi-Fi coverage.
+With Apple Watch Ultra 3 and later, you can send your location via satellite when you’re off the grid with no cellular and Wi-Fi coverage.
-You can send your location from your Apple Watch Ultra 3 to your friends and family, even when you’re somewhere with no cellular and Wi-Fi coverage.
+You can send your location from your Apple Watch Ultra 3 or later to your friends and family, even when you’re somewhere with no cellular and Wi-Fi coverage.
-To connect to a satellite, you need to be outside with a clear view of the sky and horizon. Your Apple Watch Ultra 3 also needs to be dry — if your watch is wet, its ability to connect to satellites might be impacted. When you use a satellite connection, the experience is different than sending your location via cellular. Learn more about [connecting to a satellite with your Apple Watch Ultra 3](https://support.apple.com/en-us/123924) .
+To connect to a satellite, you need to be outside with a clear view of the sky and horizon. Your Apple Watch Ultra also needs to be dry — if your watch is wet, its ability to connect to satellites might be impacted. When you use a satellite connection, the experience is different than sending your location via cellular. Learn more about [connecting to a satellite with your Apple Watch Ultra](https://support.apple.com/en-us/123924) .
-Sending your location via satellite is free for two years after the activation of an Apple Watch Ultra 3. Learn more about the feature's [requirements and availability](https://support.apple.com/en-us/125128#availability) .
+Sending your location via satellite is free for two years after the activation of an Apple Watch Ultra 3 or later. Learn more about the feature's [requirements and availability](https://support.apple.com/en-us/125128#availability) .
-[Try the Satellite Connection demo](https://support.apple.com/en-us/123924#demo) on your Apple Watch Ultra 3 to see how it works.
+[Try the Satellite Connection demo](https://support.apple.com/en-us/123924#demo) on your Apple Watch Ultra to see how it works.
-- Open the Find People app on your Apple Watch Ultra 3.
+- Open the Find My app on your Apple Watch Ultra.
-- Scroll down, then tap Me.
+- Tap the button in the top-left corner, then tap Me.
-- Tap the back button to return to the Find People list, then tap Share My Location to choose the people you want to share your location with. You can also set up your location-sharing friend list [on your iPhone](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/share-your-location-iph01954dc44/ios) .
+- Tap the button in the upper-left corner, then tap People.
+
+- Swipe up from the bottom of the screen, then tap Share Location.
+
+- Choose the people you want to share your location with. You can also set up your location-sharing friend list [on your iPhone](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/share-your-location-iph01954dc44/ios) .
-- Wear Apple Watch Ultra 3 naturally on your wrist, then ensure it has a clear line of sight to the sky. If you’re under heavy foliage or surrounded by other obstructions, you might not be able to connect to a satellite.
+- Wear Apple Watch Ultra naturally on your wrist, then ensure it has a clear line of sight to the sky. If you’re under heavy foliage or surrounded by other obstructions, you might not be able to connect to a satellite.
-When you're somewhere with no cellular and Wi-Fi coverage, you can tap the satellite icon on your watch face or in Control Center to see all available satellite features. You can also open the Settings app on your Apple Watch Ultra 3 and tap Satellite.
+When you're somewhere with no cellular and Wi-Fi coverage, you can tap the satellite icon on your watch face or in Control Center to see all available satellite features. You can also open the Settings app on your Apple Watch Ultra and tap Satellite.

+- You need an Apple Watch Ultra 3 or later.

+- [You need to connect to a satellite with your Apple Watch Ultra](https://support.apple.com/en-us/123924) . 1

+- You need an active carrier plan associated with your Apple Watch Ultra. [Check which carriers in your country or region offer cellular service for Apple Watch Ultra](https://www.apple.com/watch/cellular/) .
-- Remember that while off-grid, satellite features aren't available on Apple Watch Ultra 3 if your iPhone is nearby and in Airplane Mode.

item.title: [UPDATED] Set up cellular on Apple Watch
item.description:
With a cellular connection on Apple Watch, you can make calls, reply to messages, receive notifications, and more — even while you’re away from your iPhone.

2 added · 2 removed

-To turn your cellular connection on or off, tap the Cellular button in Control Center. On the screen that appears, tap Cellular.
+To turn your cellular connection on or off, tap the Cellular button in Control Center. On the screen that appears, tap Cellular. On this screen, you can also verify your plan’s carrier and connection status if you're having trouble with cellular. If Plan or Status is missing, contact your carrier for help.
-If you have Apple Watch Series 11, Apple Watch SE 3, or Apple Watch Ultra 3, your watch can connect to 4G LTE and 5G networks, where available.
+If you have Apple Watch Series 11 and later, Apple Watch SE 3, or Apple Watch Ultra 3 and later, your watch can connect to 4G LTE and 5G networks, where available.

item.title: [UPDATED] Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency modes for AirPods
item.description:
You can switch between Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency listening modes on your AirPods 4 and later, AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max, depending on how much of your surroundings you want to hear. You can also turn off listening modes.

23 added · 21 removed

-You can switch between Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency listening modes on your AirPods Pro and AirPods Max, depending on how much of your surroundings you want to hear. You can also turn off listening modes.
+You can switch between Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency listening modes on your AirPods 4 and later, AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max, depending on how much of your surroundings you want to hear. You can also turn off listening modes.
-With Active Noise Cancellation, an outward-facing microphone or microphones detect external sounds, which your AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods Pro 1, AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 1, and AirPods Max 2 then counter with anti-noise, canceling the external sounds before you hear them. An inward-facing microphone listens inside your ear for unwanted internal sounds, which your AirPods also counter with anti-noise.
+With Active Noise Cancellation, an outward-facing microphone or microphones detect external sounds, which your AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods 5 (both models), AirPods Pro 1, AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 1, and AirPods Max 2 then counter with anti-noise, canceling the external sounds before you hear them. An inward-facing microphone listens inside your ear for unwanted internal sounds, which your AirPods also counter with anti-noise.
-If you have AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, or AirPods Max 2 and the [latest version of iOS or iPadOS](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118575) , you can also use [Adaptive Audio](https://support.apple.com/en-us/104979) , which adjusts the noise cancellation for you in response to and based on your surroundings.
+If you have AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods 5 (both models), AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, or AirPods Max 2 and the [latest version of iOS or iPadOS](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118575) , you can also use [Adaptive Audio](https://support.apple.com/en-us/104979) , which adjusts the noise cancellation for you in response to and based on your surroundings.
-### Switch between listening modes on your AirPods 4 (ANC) or AirPods Pro
+### Switch between listening modes on your AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods 5 (both models), or AirPods Pro
-When you're wearing both AirPods, press and hold the force sensor on either AirPod to switch between Active Noise Cancellation, Transparency mode, and Off. With AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods Pro 2, and AirPods Pro 3, you can also switch to Adaptive Audio. You can customize which modes to switch between in AirPods Settings on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
+When you're wearing both AirPods, press and hold the force sensor on either AirPod to switch between Active Noise Cancellation, Transparency mode, and Off. With AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods 5 (both models), AirPods Pro 2, and AirPods Pro 3, you can also switch to Adaptive Audio. You can customize which modes to switch between in AirPods Settings on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
-To use Active Noise Cancellation with one AirPod only, use your iPhone or iPad to go to Settings > Accessibility > AirPods, and turn on "Noise Cancellation with One AirPod." Then press and hold the force sensor to switch between listening modes.
+To use Active Noise Cancellation with one AirPod only, use your iPhone or iPad to go to the Settings app, then tap Accessibility. Below Accessories, tap AirPods, tap the name of your AirPods, and turn on "Noise Cancellation with One AirPod." Then press and hold the force sensor to switch between listening modes.

item.title: [UPDATED] About the USB-C to Lightning Adapter
item.description:
The USB-C to Lightning Adapter works with iPhone or iPad models that have a USB-C connector. Use this single adapter to connect your iPhone or iPad with USB-C to a Lightning accessory for charging, data, and audio.

1 added · 1 removed

-You can use the USB-C to Lightning Adapter with wired CarPlay in most vehicles. However, some combinations of adapters, cables, and vehicle entertainment systems might disrupt the wired CarPlay connection. In this situation or for cars that support only wired CarPlay, use a direct connection with the [Beats USB-A to USB-C Woven Cable](https://www.apple.com/shop/product/mdgg4ll/a/beats-usb-a-to-usb-c-woven-cable-15-m-5-ft-bolt-black) or a similar USB-A to USB-C cable.
+You can use the USB-C to Lightning Adapter with wired CarPlay in most vehicles. However, some combinations of adapters, cables, and vehicle entertainment systems might disrupt the wired CarPlay connection. In this situation or for cars that support only wired CarPlay, use a direct connection with a USB-A to USB-C cable, such as the [Beats USB-A to USB-C Woven Cable](https://www.apple.com/shop/product/mdgg4ll/a/beats-usb-a-to-usb-c-woven-cable-15-m-5-ft-bolt-black) .
